stories.title: US withdraws from 66 international bodies including India-led ISA (Jan 7)
stories.body: executive order covering IRENA, IPCC, IUCN, UNFCCC, UNFPA, UN Water under the "America First" review; the US also formally exited WHO after 78 years.

stories.title: India becomes the world's first country to commercially produce bio-bitumen
stories.body: announced Jan 7 by Minister Nitin Gadkari; CSIR-developed technology converts paddy straw via pyrolysis; 15% blending can save ~₹4,500 crore in forex.
